title: Meet ROOMi 구성 고르기
question: Meet ROOMi 페이지의 구성을 골라 주세요. 셋 다 같은 'CD 싱글 패키지' 세계 안에서 구도만 달라요.

options.label: Jewel-case tray
options.thesis: 페이지 첫 화면이 열린 CD 케이스의 트레이예요. 핑크·보라로 인쇄된 ROOMi 디스크가 크게 놓이고, 브랜드 스토리는 트레이 카드에 적혀 있어요.
options.viewport: Composition: the first viewport is an opened jewel case seen straight on, filling the screen: on the right half, a large screen-printed CD (hot pink and violet ink, the ROOMi logo printed on it, the matte silver ring visible) sitting in the clear tray; the left half is the tray card in light gray paper carrying "BRAND STORY" as a small label and the brand story text in clean grotesk at reading size. A thin translucent polycarbonate sheen crosses the whole viewport. The section below begins with a huge hot-pink "ABOUT US" set flush left, with the black sprayed X over its corner.
options.risk: 디스크와 케이스가 소품처럼 보이면 장식에 그칠 수 있어요.

options.label: Liner-notes spread
options.thesis: CD 부클릿을 펼친 두 페이지. 왼쪽은 공연장 사진, 오른쪽은 라이너 노트처럼 조판된 브랜드 스토리와 트랙리스트 목차예요.
options.viewport: Composition: the first viewport is an open CD booklet spread laid flat, a thin center gutter running down the middle. Left page: a full-bleed flash-lit concert crowd photo with the two-wordmark logo printed over it in a pink-to-violet gradient. Right page: light gray paper set like liner notes: "BRAND STORY" small, the brand story in two narrow columns, and a numbered tracklist used as the page's table of contents: "01 Brand Story / 02 About Us / 03 Value / 04 How". The section below begins with the three value icons (glossy isometric 3D buttons: a play button, a layered disc, stacked tiles) on light gray.
options.risk: 두 페이지 구성이 좁은 화면에서는 위아래로 쌓여야 해요.

options.label: Fold-out poster insert
options.thesis: CD 안에 접혀 있는 포스터를 펼친 느낌. 접힌 자국이 그리드가 되고, 그 칸마다 섹션이 들어가요.
options.viewport: Composition: the first viewport is a fold-out poster insert being opened: the screen is divided by visible fold creases into a 4-panel grid (slight paper relief and shadow along the creases). The largest panel holds the flash-lit concert crowd photo with the gradient two-wordmark logo; the next panel holds "BRAND STORY" and the text in grotesk on light gray paper; a narrow panel holds a vertical OBI-like strip in hot pink with "MEET ROOMi" and the tracklist "01 Brand Story / 02 About Us / 03 Value / 04 How". Below the fold, the next section begins with a huge hot-pink "ABOUT US".
options.risk: 접힌 자국이 과하면 산만해 보일 수 있어요.
